name: mylar3
title: Mylar3
description: Follows comic series and downloads new and missing issues through your indexers and download client, then renames and files them. After deploying, open Settings: it needs a free ComicVine API key (Web Interface tab) before it can search, and /comics as the comic location. It has no sign-in until you set one in the same place.

variables.name: MYLAR3_COMICS
variables.label: Comics folder
variables.description: The folder on this server your comics live in, mounted at /comics

variables.name: MYLAR3_DOWNLOADS
variables.label: Downloads folder
variables.description: The folder on this server your download client saves into, mounted at /downloads
